tour.label: Guide
tour.welcomeBody: A personal notebook for everything you read, watch and learn. Let me show you the essentials in one minute.
tour.libraryBody: All your books and videos, each with its status (Planned → Reading → Read), rating and dates.
tour.addBody: Add a book or a video: type its title or paste a link — the rest fills in. Add a book’s PDF and you can read and listen to it here.
tour.notesBody: Every thought you marked is gathered here — with its page and book.
tour.reviewBody: The AI writes the most important questions from what you read and asks them again just before you would forget.
tour.assistantBody: Say what you need in plain words: add a book, make questions, explain… Send a book’s PDF and it does everything. It asks before every change. Daily limit: {limit}.
tour.writeBody: Write your own book — your life or your family’s story. The AI asks, you speak or type.
tour.readBody: A book with its PDF gets “Read” and “Audiobook” buttons. While reading, select text: “Quote”, “Note” or “Ask AI”.
tour.guideBody: The full guide lives in Settings: every section explained in plain words. Learn from there whenever you like. Enjoy!
tour.plansBody: Start each day here: tick your tasks and the percent counts itself.

audiobook.intro: The AI reads the whole book closely: its genre, tone, characters and how they speak, how hard words are pronounced, its chapters. Then it gives each character a fitting voice and reads the book fluently, like a professional narrator.
audiobook.step2: Finding the genre, tone and chapters…
audiobook.takes: Usually 1–3 minutes. The analysis continues even if you close the page.
